about: Republika Srpska: the toll price list at the Aleksandrovac toll station (naplatno mjesto), 'na osnovu Uredbe o visini putarine, član 4. stav 1, Službeni glasnik Republike Srpske br. 89/19 od 28.10.2019', published by the operator only as an image in a PDF. Transcribed by hand; tools/tables fetches the PDF again and says if it has changed (sha256). Rows: the entry station ('iz pravca') to Aleksandrovac, KM with VAT, by class: IA (motorcycles), I (two axles, up to 1.3 m at the first axle and under 1.9 m), II, III (two or three axles over 1.3 m, or with a trailer, under 2.9 m), IV (four or more axles, over 1.3 m at the first axle and 2.9 m or more in all).
